title: TriggerEventRequest
description: Request to trigger a webhook event for all of a tenant's matching subscriptions

eventType.description: Event type to trigger. Any lowercase domain.entity.action value of 2-4 segments is accepted; webhooks registered for this exact value receive it.

eventData.description: Arbitrary JSON payload delivered verbatim as the 'data' member of the webhook envelope. Not schema-validated - any JSON object is accepted.
